title: 2020s Foreign Affairs Magazine Archive
gist: This record is a bare navigational index of Foreign Affairs magazine issues from January/February 2020 through September/October 2026, with no analytical content or article text — it carries essentially no standalone investor signal.

insights.claim: Foreign Affairs has published on a continuous bimonthly (six-issues-per-year) cadence from January/February 2020 through September/October 2026, spanning volumes 99 through 105, with no gaps or skipped issues evident in the archive listing.
insights.speaker: Foreign Affairs
insights.so_what: Confirms the publication's operational continuity through the 2020-2026 period covering COVID, the Ukraine war, and the second Trump administration; not itself an actionable market signal.
